evidence.notes: MergeResult exposes the Salesforce-shaped nullable Database result errors value.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseSmallResultDtosTest { @isTest static void smallResultDtoAccessorsStayExplicit() { Account master = new Account(Name = 'Master'); insert master; Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Duplicate'); insert duplicate; Database.MergeResult merged = Database.merge(master, duplicate, false); System.assert(merged.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(null, merged.getErrors()); } }
